title: PerWorldScoreBoard
body:
PerWorldScoreboard

A powerful and lightweight Paper plugin that allows you to display different scoreboards for each world on your server.

you can Customize scoreboard of config.yml

Perfect for Survival, SkyWars, BedWars, Practice, KitPvP, and any multi-world server setup.

Features

✅ Different scoreboard per world

✅ World grouping support

✅ Fully customizable titles and lines

✅ Automatic scoreboard updates

✅ Placeholder support

✅ Lightweight and optimized

✅ Easy configuration

✅ Paper 1.20.1+ support

| Command                            | Description             |
| ---------------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| `/psb reload`                      | Reload configuration    |
| `/psb creategroup <name>`          | Create a group          |
| `/psb addworld <group> <world>`    | Add world to group      |
| `/psb removeworld <group> <world>` | Remove world from group |
| `/psb deletegroup <name>`          | Delete group            |
| `/psb list`                        | List groups and worlds  |
| `/psb update`                      | Force scoreboard update |

Ideal For
Survival Servers
BedWars Networks
SkyWars Servers
Practice Servers
KitPvP Servers
Multi-World Communities
